text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After consulting with Smart Falcon, the 
place chosen for a relaxing break was a 
Dubai-esque local beach. Though Eishin 
Flash was bewildered at first—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon and her Trainer affirmed who 
she was and cheered her on. Their words 
sparked doubt in her mind over whether 
taking the passive route had really been 
the right choice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a final push to help Eishin Flash 
confront herself— the Trainer comes up 
with a rematch against Mr. C.B.
